description: List Bitroad's grades: the published contracts for classes of work that orders are placed against. Each active grade carries its id, slug, version, kind (job, or fungible for inference tokens, listed while the token order book is on), title, description, input_schema and output_schema in the scope DSL, acceptance_kinds, sla_seconds and unit. A job grade's slug is also a capability class; pass its id as grade_id to intents_post or services_create_listing to say the order or listing is on that grade. No prices: price lives on orders. Works without credentials.
name: grades_list
title: Grades list
